rights.copyingScope: Selected factual item identities, named portions and numerical quantities. No source PDF, layout, prose, artwork or restaurant logo is republished. No open-data license, partnership or ownership is claimed.
rights.legalObservation: Current linked Legal & Privacy page reviewed in browser. It addresses personal information and has no explicit commercial data-harvesting or database restriction. This is not a legal opinion or a granted whole-catalogue license.

limits: Currently linked source edition is June 2025, not a current whole-menu audit.
Only named portions and explicitly printed without-sauce variants are included. No other customization effects are inferred.
Three restaurant-published dip servings stay separate from chicken, fish and fries.
Source ounce labels are retained as size names alongside native grams; no fluid-ounce-to-gram density is invented.
Source micronutrients expressed as percentages are not converted into guessed absolute quantities.
No claim of location availability, ingredient completeness, or allergen safety.
